shortDescription: Integrates with Brazil's PJE electronic court system to enable secure access to legal case data, document retrieval, and court process monitoring for Brazilian judicial workflows.

rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: TypeScript-based MCP server that provides integration with Brazil's PJE (Processo Judicial Eletrônico) electronic court system, enabling AI assistants to interact with legal case data and court processes. The implementation includes certificate management for secure authentication, PDF processing capabilities for legal documents, and support for multiple Brazilian courts and tribunals. Built for legal professionals and developers working with Brazilian judicial data, it facilitates automated case monitoring, document retrieval, and legal process analysis through conversational interfaces with Claude Desktop and other MCP-compatible clients.
